---
title: "CUDA compatibility matrix"
---

Finding the right combination of libtorch, {torch}, and CUDA can be tricky. This guide provides a clear compatibility matrix to help you set-up your environment.

## {torch} versions compatibility

| {torch} | libtorch | Suitable CUDA versions  |
|:-------:|:--------:|:-----------------------:|
| 0.17.x  |  2.8.0   |       12.6, 12.8        |
| 0.16.x  |  2.7.1   |       12.6, 12.8        |
| 0.15.x  |  2.5.1   |       11.8, 12.4        |
| 0.14.x  |  2.5.1   |       11.8, 12.4        |
| 0.13.0  |  2.0.1   |       11.7, 11.8        |
| 0.12.0  |  2.0.1   |       11.7, 11.8        |
| 0.11.0  |  1.13.1  |       11.6, 11.7        |
| 0.10.0  |  1.13.1  | 11.6 (Linux only), 11.7 |

: torch compatibility matrix

## CUDA version compatibility

| CUDA version |  Suitable {torch} version   |
|:------------:|:---------------------------:|
|     12.8     |      0.16.x to 0.17.x       |
|     12.6     |      0.16.x to 0.17.x       |
|     12.4     |      0.14.x to 0.15.x       |
|     11.8     |      0.12.0 to 0.15.x       |
|     11.7     |      0.10.0 to 0.13.0       |
|     11.6     | 0.10.0 (Linux only), 0.11.0 |

  <input type="radio" id="cuda-12.8" name="cuda" value="12.8" checked>

  <input type="radio" id="cuda-12.6" name="cuda" value="12.6">
  <label for="cuda-12.6">12.6</label>

  <label for="cuda-12.4">12.4</label>

  <label for="cuda-11.8">11.8</label>
  <input type="radio" id="cuda-11.7" name="cuda" value="11.7">
  <label for="cuda-11.7">11.7</label>

<h4>4. Run this command in R</h4>
<div id="install-command-box">
  <code id="install-command">
    Select your options above...
  </code>
  <p id="error-message" style="display: none;"></p>
</div>

<script>
  // Keep in sync with the compatibility tables above.
  var compatibility = {
    "11.6": { torch_range: "0.10.0 (Linux only) or 0.11.0", rec_version: "0.11.0", linux_only: true },
    "11.7": { torch_range: "0.10.0 to 0.13.0", rec_version: "0.13.0", linux_only: false },
    "11.8": { torch_range: "0.12.0 to 0.15.x", rec_version: "0.15.1", linux_only: false },
    "12.4": { torch_range: "0.14.x to 0.15.x", rec_version: "0.15.1", linux_only: false },
    "12.6": { torch_range: "0.16.x to 0.17.x", rec_version: "0.17.0", linux_only: false },
    "12.8": { torch_range: "0.16.x to 0.17.x", rec_version: "0.17.0", linux_only: false }
  };

  function updateCommand() {
    var selectedOs = document.querySelector('input[name="os"]:checked').value;
    var selectedCuda = document.querySelector('input[name="cuda"]:checked').value;
    var selectedDebug = document.querySelector('input[name="debug"]:checked').value;
    var outputElement = document.getElementById('install-command');
    var errorElement = document.getElementById('error-message');
    var command = "";
    var error = "";

    var debugInstall = selectedDebug === "manual"
      ? 'Sys.setenv(TORCH_INSTALL_DEBUG = "1")\n'
      : "";
    var debugCuda = selectedDebug === "manual"
      ? 'Sys.setenv(CUDA = "' + selectedCuda + '")\n'
      : "";

    if (selectedOs === 'macos') {
      command = "# On macOS, {torch} uses the 'mps' backend for GPU acceleration.\n" +
                debugInstall +
                "install.packages(\"torch\")\n" +
                "library(torch)";
      if (selectedCuda !== 'cpu') {
        error = "Note: CUDA is not supported on macOS. Falling back to CPU/MPS install.";
      }
    } else if (selectedCuda === 'cpu') {
      command = "# This command installs the CPU-only version of {torch}.\n" +
                debugInstall +
                "install.packages(\"torch\")\n" +
                "library(torch)";
    } else if (selectedCuda === '12.8' || selectedCuda === '12.6') {
      command = "# This command installs the latest supported CUDA version of {torch}.\n" +
                debugInstall + debugCuda +
                "install.packages(\"torch\")\n" +
                "library(torch)";
    } else {
      var info = compatibility[selectedCuda];
      if (info.linux_only && selectedOs !== 'linux') {
        error = "CUDA " + selectedCuda + " with {torch} " + info.torch_range +
                " is only supported on Linux. Please select another combination.";
      } else {
        command = "# For CUDA " + selectedCuda + ", the recommended {torch} R package version is " + info.rec_version + ").\n" +
                  "# You may need the 'remotes' package: install.packages(\"remotes\")\n" +
                  debugInstall + debugCuda +
                  "remotes::install_version(\"torch\", version = \"" + info.rec_version + "\")\n" +
                  "library(torch)";
      }
    }

    outputElement.textContent = command;
    if (error) {
      errorElement.textContent = error;
      errorElement.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
      errorElement.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  function applyCudaVisibility() {
    var selectedOs = document.querySelector('input[name="os"]:checked').value;
    var cudaSelector = document.getElementById('cuda-selector');
    if (selectedOs === 'macos') {
      cudaSelector.style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('cuda-none').checked = true;
    } else {
      cudaSelector.style.display = 'block';
    }
  }

  function setDefaultOS() {
    var platform = (navigator.userAgentData
      ? navigator.userAgentData.platform
      : navigator.platform || "").toLowerCase();

    if (platform.startsWith("win")) {
      document.getElementById("os-windows").checked = true;
    } else if (platform.startsWith("mac")) {
      document.getElementById("os-macos").checked = true;
    } else {
      document.getElementById("os-linux").checked = true;
    }
    applyCudaVisibility();
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('input[name="os"]').forEach(function(radio) {
    radio.addEventListener('change', function() {
      applyCudaVisibility();
      updateCommand();
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('input[name="cuda"]').forEach(function(radio) {
    radio.addEventListener('change', updateCommand);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('input[name="debug"]').forEach(function(radio) {
    radio.addEventListener('change', updateCommand);
  });

  setDefaultOS();
  updateCommand();
</script>
